name: math-coach-v1
description: Review #14 on 2aa2dc0: a v1-era Custom profile saved Coach on with stale table picks (8, 9). Custom's Coach means every table, so its race keeps the v1 best key race|x|coach|m10|l10.

steps.label: a v1 Custom coach profile (Coach on, 8 and 9 left picked) races every table and keeps its v1 best key (review #14)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}var n=0;while(!document.getElementById('runLayer').hidden&&n<30){type(ans());n++;await sleep(330);}var s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('math.sessions.pAva.v1'));return n===10&&s.length===1&&s[0].cfgKey==='race|x|coach|m10|l10';})()
